title: Next quarter, on the phone
direction: A×C · Round 11 · GTM Intelligence body, recomposed for the phone (1440 and tablet as approved in round 10)
summary: The approved worked example (six calls with buyers who said no read together; one thing added to next quarter's plan, one thing stopped), recomposed for the phone: each step its own full-width row, each note a dated entry (the week over the quote, the quote across the full measure), the paper plan with phone margins; same words, same order, same red tab.

reference.site: The approved homepage handover (handover/U): the old line struck, the new line rising in
reference.borrowed: Strike-and-rise as the verb of change; a ruled list on a paper page; leaders to a rule; one solid subject (the count).
reference.kelwin: A real mechanism in the client's own material (lost-deal calls → next quarter's plan); the plan is the head's red week-13 page (its tab), its rows the head's lanes in the same words.

motion: entrance: the kit's claim rise; the plate waits, hidden, until the log is half on screen, then fades in on the starting plan (the empty first slot dashed, so the page never changes height).
step 01 We read the calls (from 400ms): six notes drop in 140ms apart; security is underlined in four and their squares fill (1100–1900); the other two dim (1800); 4 of 6 rises (1950).

step 02 We add one thing (2.9s later at the earliest, and only once the plan is half on screen): a line runs from the count into the plan's first row; the slot clears and the new item rises in; the rows below renumber; New, then Kept.
step 03 We stop one thing (2s after step 02): Rebuild the contact list every week is struck and dims; Stopped, 0 replies in 13 weeks. Settled about 1.1s later.

interaction: each step button shows the end of its step (forwards or back, about a second) and stops the pass for good; keyboard focus stops it too; Replay runs it again; the current step carries aria-current=step; a reader's press is spoken (aria-live).
reduced motion: the end of step 03; the buttons still switch the plate. No script: the end of step 03 without the connector (it is drawn only once T.js has measured it).

phone (round 11): the same three steps and timings; each step's row is full width (numeral and verb on one line, 20px); notes are dated entries, the week over the quote; plan items wrap without a one-word last line.
notes: Illustrative throughout (the label row says so once): every quote, the count and the plan rows. The six weeks and four security calls match the head's lane; the plan rows are the head's lanes in the same words. Round 11: 1440 and tablet pixel-identical to r10-intel/T; only the phone rules changed.
